reasons.action: The caller explicitly asks the man at the counter to speak the recorded line again, word for word. That is a requested vocal performance, so the action is request-governed; the audio reference supplies only timbre/delivery, not the behavior itself, and there is no visual source plate whose static pose could compete.
reasons.medium: No visual reference exists; the sole asset is an audio vocal-timbre reference, which has no authority over rendering medium. Rendering-medium permission is already pinned to no_reference, so the medium is request-governed (unstyled live-action default).
reasons.wardrobe: With no visual reference, no observed clothing has authority. Nothing in the brief specifies garments or accessories, so wardrobe falls to the request, which imposes no constraints and leaves the default unspecified appearance.
reasons.lighting: There is no visual reference lighting to retain or replace, and the request contains no instruction about light sources, direction or quality. Lighting is therefore request-governed with no specified treatment.
reasons.framing: The request gives no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement instruction; aspect ratio and duration are metadata, not framing directions. With no visual reference, framing is request-governed with no imposed composition.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies a color or tonal grade, and the request specifies no hue, saturation or contrast treatment. Palette is therefore request-governed with no specified grade.
